headline: 3M Stock Surges Following $7.35 Billion Forever Chemicals Settlement
summary: Shares of 3M rose after the company announced a $7.35 billion settlement regarding forever chemicals litigation.
why: Mass tort and environmental litigation settlements remove major financial overhangs and long-term legal uncertainties for large industrial conglomerates.

impacts.name: 3M
impacts.why: Resolving a massive multi-billion dollar liability removes a key source of financial risk for the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The settlement removes significant legal uncertainty and tail-risk related to environmental liabilities, boosting investor sentiment.
